instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand resting in front of your thighs, palms facing back.
2. Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Raise both dumbbells straight in front of you until your arms are parallel to the floor.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso still and avoid swinging or using momentum.
2. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
3. Keep your wrists neutral and shoulders down, away from your ears.
4. Use a weight you can control through a full range of motion.

instructions:
1. Stand facing a bench, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Place your right heel on the bench with the toes pointing up. Keep your left foot flat on the floor.
3. Keep your right leg straight and lean your torso forward from the hips.
4. Hold the stretch and feel tension in your right calf.
5. Switch legs and repeat.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the stretched leg fully straight to target the gastrocnemius.
2. Hinge from the hips, do not round your back.
3. Ease into the stretch slowly, no bouncing.
4. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band in both hands.
2. Place the center of the band under your right forefoot.
3. Extend your right leg in front of you, heel on the floor and toes pointing up.
4. Pull the band gently and hinge your torso forward, keeping your back straight.
5. Hold the stretch, then switch legs and repeat.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the stretched leg straight and toes pulled toward you.
2. Keep the standing leg slightly bent for balance.
3. Hinge from the hips, do not round your spine.
4. Increase tension gradually as flexibility improves.

instructions:
1. Stand facing a cable machine, feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a straight bar to the high pulley.
2. Hold the bar with both hands, arms extended, palms facing down.
3. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward a little at the hips.
4. Keep your arms straight and pull the bar in an arc down to your thighs, contracting your lats.
5. Return the bar slowly to the start, keeping tension in your lats.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from your lats, not your arms.
2. Keep your elbows nearly straight throughout.
3. Brace your core to keep your lower back stable.
4. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides.
2. Brace your core and stand tall.
3. Place your right hand behind your head and keep your left arm down by your leg.
4. Bend your torso to the left until you feel a stretch along your right side.
5. Hold the stretch, then return and repeat on the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips level and do not push them sideways.
2. Move slowly and hold without bouncing.
3. Keep your spine long, do not round forward.
4. Increase the bend gradually as flexibility improves.
